_note: Playstyle for the Squall build of the Storm construct. Unlike the Collegium list it has no Relic, so the Ascension win is live and aspect 3 is worth climbing for its own sake as well as for its power. The plan is to make attacking it expensive and then out-trade: Weighted Hollow taxes every Strike, the Mastery shuts Strikes out of the Combat after any landed Storm Art, and Terms of the Pact and Stillness cover the rest. Its own Arts all pay Fervor, so damage and the climb are the same action and Fervor is worth a lot. Three Allies and the stripping package (Scorn, Sever the Leyline, Siphon's Drain, Smiting Bolt) do the board work. It declares Combat readily, because every Art it owns advances two plans at once.
name: storm_unbound
